source_input.packet_supplied_packet_sha256_basis: The input does not state the hash basis. This supplied value is preserved separately from the actual raw-file hash and the whole-JSON canonical hash.
source_input.canonical_hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with keys sorted, separators comma and colon without whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, and no terminal newline. Every field is included unless an explicitly named field-exclusion variant is stated.

hash_conventions.actual_raw_sha256: SHA-256 of exact file bytes, including the terminal newline when present. All four primary artifacts are re-read after writing to verify these values.
hash_conventions.whole_json_canonical_sha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with keys sorted, separators comma and colon without whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, and no terminal newline. Every field is included unless an explicitly named field-exclusion variant is stated.
hash_conventions.text_artifact_canonical_hash: No JSON canonical hash is assigned to reconstruction.txt; its exact-text commitment is its actual raw SHA-256.
hash_conventions.manifest_self_hash: The exact raw hash of this manifest is committed in the separate file provenance/manifest.sha256; the manifest does not embed its own hash.
hash_conventions.packet_sha256: Only the field packet_supplied_packet_sha256 reproduces the value carried by the input packet. Whole-JSON canonical hashes are separately named and are not presented as that supplied digest.

scope: Only anonymous-statement reconstruction, seven slots, exposure report, and run provenance. No proof, source identity search, or source fidelity verdict.
